method: Each case constructs the real feature object with its native constructor, seeds a real original Random, and calls the native place() entry. Every Random word, every Feature::_placeBlock attempt and the final block state are native observations.

source_context.blocksource: BlockSource(Level, Dimension, ChunkSource, true, true) with BlockTickingQueue(Tick(1)); events suppressed
source_context.scene: a 20x20 ground column area, Y 2..21, reset through the original BlockSource::setBlock with flag 0

encoding: block_names interns the names; each scene is base64(zlib(repeated <hhhH> x,y,z,name_index)); a case stores only the cells that changed from its scene.
